import { type PropertyValues } from 'lit';
import { KrdsElement } from '../base.js';
import { FormControlController } from '../../controllers/form-control-controller.js';
import { type DateValue } from '../calendar/model.js';
export interface DateInputTranslations {
    startLabel: string;
    endLabel: string;
    formatHint: string;
    openCalendar: string;
    calendarTitle: string;
    requiredError: string;
    formatError: string;
    incompleteRangeError: string;
    orderError: string;
    minError: string;
    maxError: string;
}
export declare class DateInput extends KrdsElement {
    static formAssociated: boolean;
    static properties: {
        mode: {
            type: StringConstructor;
        };
        value: {
            attribute: boolean;
        };
        defaultValue: {
            attribute: boolean;
        };
        name: {
            type: StringConstructor;
            reflect: boolean;
        };
        required: {
            type: BooleanConstructor;
        };
        disabled: {
            type: BooleanConstructor;
            reflect: boolean;
        };
        min: {
            type: StringConstructor;
        };
        max: {
            type: StringConstructor;
        };
        withCalendar: {
            attribute: string;
            type: BooleanConstructor;
        };
        referenceDate: {
            attribute: string;
        };
        today: {
            type: StringConstructor;
        };
        translations: {
            attribute: boolean;
        };
        error: {
            type: StringConstructor;
        };
        invalid: {
            type: BooleanConstructor;
        };
        autocomplete: {
            type: StringConstructor;
        };
        draftStart: {
            state: boolean;
        };
        draftEnd: {
            state: boolean;
        };
        localError: {
            state: boolean;
        };
        popup: {
            state: boolean;
        };
    };
    mode: 'single' | 'range';
    value: DateValue | undefined;
    defaultValue: DateValue | undefined;
    name: string;
    required: boolean;
    disabled: boolean;
    min: string | undefined;
    max: string | undefined;
    withCalendar: boolean;
    referenceDate: string;
    today: string | undefined;
    translations: Partial<DateInputTranslations>;
    error: string;
    invalid: boolean;
    autocomplete: string;
    private draftStart;
    private draftEnd;
    private localError;
    private popup;
    readonly formControl: FormControlController;
    private state;
    private previous;
    private initialMode?;
    private composing;
    private localAffected;
    constructor();
    get committedValue(): DateValue;
    private display;
    willUpdate(_changed: PropertyValues): void;
    updated(): void;
    private focusCalendar;
    private rawValue;
    private validation;
    private validationAnchor;
    private syncForm;
    private commit;
    validateSubmission(): boolean;
    resetControl(): void;
    restoreControl(state: string | FormData | File | null): void;
    formResetCallback(): void;
    formDisabledCallback(value: boolean): void;
    formStateRestoreCallback(state: string | FormData | File | null): void;
    private input;
    private key;
    private groupBlur;
    private accept;
    render(): import("lit").TemplateResult<1>;
}
